## Function Order Deck

Kahn layers over dependsOn, the deck sorted by them, and the external dependencies.

Behaviour: orderDeck(cards). An id of dependsOn that no card carries is external and counts as done. Layer after layer: the cards not placed whose in-deck dependencies are all placed, ids sorted (JavaScript's default string order); a layer that would be empty while cards remain → {ok: false, error: "dependency cycle among <the ids not placed, sorted, joined by ', '>"}. → {ok: true, cards: sorted by (layer, id), generations: the layers, externalDependsOn: per card in that order with at least one external id, its external ids in dependsOn order}.

## Function Plan Spec

The whole plan of `morph plan --spec`, the old Morph's cut kept card for card.

Behaviour: planSpec({record, map, spec, components, judge, hasFile}). Faults in this order: the map's language → Resolve Profile(null, map.language), unknown → "the map: <its error>"; Select Components(record, components) error. docs = map.docs without the spec path. Cut Component per selected Component in order (its error is the result), then, P19, its dependencies (componentDependencies, record order): the first with a doc that hasFile denies → "dependency '<name>' of Component '<component>': doc file not found: <doc>". Across cuts: a card whose slice the map did not set gets the first target of every dependsOn entry naming a cut card of another Component appended (when absent). Extra cards in map order: component null → kept; a component no Component of the record has by name or slug → "extra card '<customId>' names Component '<component>' the record does not have (have: <the record's Component names joined by ', '>)"; kept when it names a selected Component, else skipped; as Card {customId, intent or "patch", targets, contextSlice or [], instruction, acceptance, model, maxTokens (null when unset), reasoning: {maxTokens: reasoningMaxTokens} or null, variants or 1, dependsOn or []}, Cut Card {component null, profile null, functions [], slicedByMap true}. When judge: Cut Judges over every Cut Card (defaultProfile = the map's profile, typescript when unset), appended. P19: for every card Cut Component made whose Component has dependencies, in card order: uses[<its customId>] = their names (record order); their docs (not null, distinct, record order) are appended, each when absent, to its contextSlice and to the slice of the card "<customId>-judge" when there is one — also when the map set the slice, as a new list (the map's own list is never changed); extra cards get none. ## Function Probe Names

The example titles of a probe, and every one the record does not give or the probe lacks.

Behaviour: pascalName(name) = language's nameWords(name), each word with its first letter upper-cased, joined ("Percent Of" → "PercentOf", "MCP mount" → "McpMount"). probeTitles(profile, text, names) → Probe Title[] in line order, text split on "\n". The go profile: a line starting "func TestProbe" + X + "Example" + n + "(" (X one or more of [A-Za-z0-9_], the longest that fits; n digits) → {function: the first of names whose pascalName is X, letter case ignored ("PMTools" is "PM Tools"), else X; n: Number(n)}. Any other profile: a line whose first non-blank characters (spaces, tabs) are "test(" or "it(", then optional spaces, then a quote (", ' or a backquote), the title running to the next same quote on the line; a title "<F> example <n>" or "<F> example <n>:<rest>" (F at least one character, n digits) → {function: F, n}; every other title is the probe's own test, skipped. checkProbeNames({id, path, profile, text, own, record, strict}) → string[]; own and record are Example Counts ({name, count}); titles = probeTitles(profile, text, record names then own names). A title met twice (an example split over several tests) counts once. strict: per own entry in order, the numbers 1..count no title gives, ascending → "card '<id>': probe <path> lacks <F> example <the numbers joined by ', '> (the record gives <count>)"; then the titles that are not (an own name, 1 ≤ n ≤ its count), grouped by function in order of first appearance, numbers distinct ascending → "card '<id>': probe <path> names <F> example <numbers>, not an example of its Functions (<own names joined by ', ', or none>)". Not strict: no lacks lines; the titles whose function is no record name or whose n is outside 1..count, grouped the same → "card '<id>': probe <path> names <F> example <numbers>, which the record does not give". The lacks lines come before the names lines.

- produces: Probe Title

## Function Read Checks

Turns a parsed checks document into typed Checks, or every problem it has.

Behaviour: validateChecks(doc: unknown). Not a plain object → {ok: false, problems: ["(root): checks must be an object"]}. Every object is checked against its key table — root: version, phase, parts, frozen, fullExclude, ownGit, cards, overrides; card: id, smoke, extra, files; file: file, min, max, lits, drop, new — first its unknown keys in the object's order ("<path>: unknown key '<k>' (known: <table joined by ', '>)"), then its keys in table order. Required: phase, a card's id, a file's file, min, max ("<path>.<key>: required"). version must be 1 ("version: must be 1"); phase and id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$; a repeated id → "cards[<i>].id: duplicate id '<id>'"; parts, extra, file non-empty strings; frozen, fullExclude, lits, drop lists ("must be a list") of non-empty strings ("<path>[<j>]: must be a non-empty string"); ownGit and new true or false ("must be true or false"); smoke a positive integer; min and max non-negative integers; cards and files non-empty lists ("must be a non-empty list"), each item an object ("cards[<i>]: must be an object"). After a card's keys: files with smoke or extra → "cards[<i>]: a judge card (files) takes no smoke or extra"; after a file's keys: min > max → "<path>: min <min> exceeds max <max>". Defaults: version 1, parts "decks/<phase>/parts", frozen DEFAULT_FROZEN = ["contour.yaml", "morph-map.json", "docs", "decks", "tests/fixtures"], fullExclude [], ownGit false, smoke, extra and files null, lits and drop [], new false. Any problem → {ok: false, problems} (document order); none → {ok: true, checks}. P35a (#45): overrides a list ("overrides: must be a list") of objects ("overrides[<i>]: must be an object"), each checked as a card at overrides[<i>] (same table and rules, duplicate ids among the overrides), except that an override's file requires only file: min, max, lits, drop, new are null when absent (Override File), min > max when both given. Then cards and overrides both given → "(root): cards and overrides exclude each other: cards lists every card, overrides only the cut's cards that differ". No cards → the cut form: cards [] and the last key overrides ([] when absent); cards given → no key overrides, as before.

- reads: Checks
- produces: Checks Result
